limitations: 24h is descriptive only and is never compared with 28d position.
7d and 28d windows overlap heavily across exports; movement is not an independent SEO experiment.
Query sheets are capped at 1000 rows. Missing rows are NO_CURRENT_BASELINE, not zero demand.
Country is searcher location, not locale-site performance. Page tables cannot be joined to query rows.
No enquiry, order, revenue or AI-citation conclusion is made from GSC.
